sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Class D permits, examinations and medical reporting
Every knowledge statement for Class D permits, examinations and medical reporting is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
Mixed pages contain commercial, school-bus and taxi/limousine licensing material; those specialty-license requirements are excluded. Reinstatement and medical rules are retained only as handbook licensing context, without diagnosis or advice.
The handbook describes a learner’s accompanying driver as over twenty-one in some places and at least twenty-one in others. Facts preserve the page-specific wording rather than silently resolving the difference. Daylight-only vision discussion spans adjacent pages and is split into separate page-bound facts.
Open source limitation (verify DE-EXAM-SUPERVISOR): The adult learner accompaniment age is stated both as at least twenty-one and over twenty-one across the handbook; issuer clarification is required before unifying those rules.
Open source limitation (verify DE-EXAM-DAYLIGHT): The daylight-only vision rule crosses a physical page boundary. Separate facts preserve the permission statement and stated vision range; combined clinical interpretation requires official clarification rather than an inferred medical rule.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
